correctness.rationale: The exact quadratic relaxation has the unique positive root gamma=(1+Q/4)^-1. The derived squared-norm update and positive factors preserve the total norm. The strict, uniformly separated highest/lower mode multiplier ratio yields exponential extinction and conservation fixes the top-mode limits; summably small deviations yield strictly positive asymptotic constants and exact rho. The exact h^4 energy recurrence is an Euler step for a uniformly Lipschitz simplex vector field with O(h^2) field error; Gronwall supplies uniform O(h^2) slow-time convergence. The relaxed time differs relatively by O(h^2), giving the physical h^-3 scale. Rational identities and numerical diagnostics replay with the included standalone checker; no infinite claim is inferred solely from sampling.

value.rationale: The result studies a natural modal-invariant gap in a widely used single-functional preservation technique. Even for decoupled linear oscillators it proves an attracting but false allocation of all modal squared norms, with exact per-mode decay rates and a sharp long-time h^-3 onset verified analytically. This informs when preserving only global energy can be qualitatively inadequate. It is not merely a local truncation observation, a known generic coupling statement, or arbitrary finite data.
